source_row.rationale: Pursed-lip breathing can help reduce the sensation of dyspnea and improve exercise tolerance by prolonging exhalation and reducing air trapping, a helpful self-management technique for COPD clients to use during activity, complementing (not replacing) prescribed bronchodilator therapy.
source_row.source_detail: Benefits of Pursed-Lip Breathing During Activity
